description: Test suite for parser functionality in the winscope project, including handling of empty traces, no-entry traces, and timestamp retrieval for real and elapsed timestamps.

classes.name: Parser
classes.description: Generic parser class for trace data, parameterized by state type.

methods.name: getTraceType
methods.description: Returns the type of trace being parsed.

methods.name: getTimestamps
methods.description: Retrieves timestamps of specified type from the trace.

methods.name: getEntry
methods.description: Retrieves a specific trace entry by index and timestamp type.

methods.name: getLengthEntries
methods.description: Returns the total number of trace entries.
